implementation_notes: Authorisation comes from a committed requirement, never from a forecast. If nobody has asked for the capability, the correct artefact is a backlog item, not an interface, option or code path.
code_sketch:
if requirement_committed(capability): implement(capability)
else: backlog.add(capability)   # not: implement(capability, speculative=True)
pitfalls: Deferral without refactoring capability becomes debt
Deleting an extension point that another team already consumes
